summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Allen had turned up in London matched with Tompkins Gilbert for £50 a side; Tom Kelly explained it was a sparring match with blackened hands, not a ring fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch', Saturday evening, September 29, 1877

facts.fact: Allen was reported to be in London, having left St. Louis under a cloud owing mostly to unfortunate business ventures
Allen was matched in London against Tompkins Gilbert, styled champion sparrer of England, in a sparring match for £50 a side
Allen was described as having resided in St. Louis over ten years and gained the title of Champion of America

notes: Gilbert match details come secondhand from Tom Kelly, interviewed at his saloon, 11 North Sixth Street.
